sanskrit: tubhyam agre pary avahan sūryāṃ vahatunā saha | punaḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha ||
english: For you they first led Sūryā forth together with the bridal procession; O Agni, now give back the bride to her husbands together with offspring.

sanskrit: punaḥ patnīm agnir adād āyuṣā saha varcasā | dīrghāyur asyā yaḥ patir jīvāti śaradaḥ śatam ||
english: Agni has given back the wife together with life and vital radiance; long-lived may be her husband — may he live a hundred autumns.

sanskrit: somasya jāyā prathamaṃ gandharvas te 'paraḥ patiḥ | tṛtīyo agniṣ ṭe patis turīyas te manuṣyajāḥ ||
english: First Soma was your husband; then the Gandharva was your next lord; Agni was your third husband; the fourth is born of mortal man.

sanskrit: somo dadad gandharvāya gandharvo dadad agnaye | rayiṃ ca putrāṃś cādād agnir mahyam atho imām ||
english: Soma gave her to the Gandharva; the Gandharva gave her to Agni; Agni gave both wealth and sons to me, and also gave this woman.

sanskrit: ā vām agan sumatir vājinīvasū ny aśvinā hṛtsu kāmā araṃsata | abhūtaṃ gopā mithunā śubhaspatī priyā aryamṇo duryām̐ aśīmahi ||
english: Good will has come to you two, O Vājinīvasus; O Aśvins, may desires find rest in your hearts. You two became guardians as a pair, as Lords of Welfare; may we attain the dear abodes of Aryaman.

sanskrit: sā mandasānā manasā śivena rayiṃ dhehi sarvavīraṃ vacasyam | sugaṃ tīrthaṃ suprapāṇaṃ śubhaspatī sthāṇuṃ pathiṣṭhām apa durmatiṃ hatam ||
english: Rejoicing with an auspicious mind, bestow wealth abundant in all heroes, worthy of praise; O Lords of Welfare, make easy the ford, well-accessible the watering-place; strike down evil thought from the most steadfast path.

sanskrit: apa rakṣāṃsy apa durmatiṃ hataṃ śubhaspatī vahator yāto asmāt | purogavo jayan rakṣāṃsy agne kṣetravit pūrvo vi mṛdho nudasva ||
english: Strike away the demons, strike away evil thought — O Lords of Welfare, having gone from here on this bridal journey; O Agni, knower of the field, going before the cows, conquering demons, thrust aside enemies from the front.

sanskrit: yā oṣadhayo yā nadyo yāni kṣetrāṇi yā vanā | te tvā vadhu prajāvatīṃ patye rakṣantu rakṣasaḥ ||
english: Whatever herbs, whatever rivers, whatever fields, whatever forests there are — let those guardians protect you, O bride rich in offspring, for your husband.

sanskrit: emaṃ panthām aganma sugaṃ svastivāhanam | yatra vīro na riṣyaty anyeṣāṃ vindate vasu ||
english: We have set forth on this easy path, bearing good fortune, where the hero suffers no harm and wins the wealth of others.

sanskrit: idaṃ su me naraḥ śṛṇuta yayāśiṣā dampatī vāmam aśnutaḥ | ye gandharvā apsarasaś ca devīr eṣu vānaspatyeṣv adyādhi tasthuḥ | syonās te asyai vadhvai bhavantu mā hiṃsiṣur vahatum uhyamānam ||
english: Hear this well from me, O men — by this blessing the master and mistress of the house attain happiness. Those Gandharvas and divine Apsarases who dwell today in these forest trees — may they be gentle to this bride; let them not harm the bridal procession as it is borne along.

sanskrit: ye vadhvaś candraṃ vahatuṃ yakṣmā yanti janām̐ anu | punas tān yajñiyā devā nayantu yata āgatāḥ ||
english: Whatever diseases follow the people and accompany the gleaming bridal procession of the bride — may the gods worthy of sacrifice lead those diseases back to where they came from.

sanskrit: mā vidan paryāyiṇo ya āsīdanti dampatī | sugena durgam atītām apa drāntv arātayaḥ ||
english: May those who roam about, who beset the master and mistress of the house, not find them; may they pass over what is hard to cross by an easy path; let the hostile ones run away.

sanskrit: saṃ kāśayāmi vahatuṃ brahmaṇā gṛhair aghoreṇa cakṣuṣā mitryeṇa | paryāṇaddhaṃ viśvarūpaṃ yad asmin syonaṃ patibhyaḥ savitā kṛṇotu tat ||
english: I illuminate the bridal procession with sacred prayer, with the houses, with a non-terrible eye, with Mitra's gaze. Whatever is bound and all-formed in this one — may Savitā make that gentle for her husbands.

sanskrit: śivā nārīyam astam āgann imaṃ dhātā lokam asyai viveda | tām aryamā bhago aśvinobhā prajāpatiḥ prajayā vardhayantu ||
english: This woman has come home as an auspicious one; Dhātā has found this world for her. May Aryaman, Bhaga, both Aśvins, and Prajāpati increase her with offspring.

sanskrit: ātmanvaty urvarā narīyam āgan tasyāṃ naro vapata bījam asyām | sā vaḥ prajāṃ janayād vakṣaṇābhyo bibhratī dudhram ṛṣabhasya retaḥ ||
english: This woman has come to a fruitful field possessed of soul; O men, sow seed in this one. Bearing the mighty seed of the bull in her flanks, may she generate offspring for you.

sanskrit: prati tiṣṭha virāḍ iva viṣṇur iveha sarasvati | dūrvevendra pra jāyatāṃ bhagasya sumatāv asat ||
english: Stand firm here like Virāj, like Viṣṇu, O Sarasvatī; may she spring forth like dūrvā grass for Indra; may she be in the good favor of Bhaga.

sanskrit: ud vām ūrmiḥ śamye hantv āpo yoktrāṇi muñcantu | māduṣkṛtau vyenasā- -aghnyau śūnam āratām ||
english: Let the wave beat on the yoke-pin; let the waters release the bonds. May the two blameless, sinless ones — not evildoers — approach prosperity.

sanskrit: aghoracakṣur apatighnī syonā śagmā suśevā suyamā gṛheṣu | prajāvatī vīrasūr devṛkāmā- -imam agniṃ gārhapatyaṃ sarpaya ||
english: With non-terrible eye, not harming the husband, gentle, prosperous, most pleasant, well-ruling in the houses — rich in offspring, bearing heroes, loving her husband's brothers — creep toward this householder's fire.

sanskrit: adevṛghny apatighnīhaidhi syonā paśubhyaḥ sumanāḥ suvīrā | vīrasūr devṛkāmā syonā saṃ tvaidhiṣīmahi sumanasyamānā ||
english: Not harming the husband's brothers, not harming the husband — be gentle, well-disposed toward the cattle, having good heroes; bearing heroes, loving the husband's brothers, gentle — may we prosper together with you being of good spirit.

sanskrit: ut tiṣṭhātaḥ kim icchantīdam āgā ahaṃ tveḍe abhibhūḥ svād gṛhāt | śūnyaiśī nirṛte yājagantha- -uttiṣṭhārāte pra pata māti raṃsthāḥ ||
english: Arise! Seeking what have you come here? I, the overpowering one, rebuke you — be gone from this house. O Nirṛti, seeker of the empty, you came here — arise, O Ill-will, fly away; do not linger here any longer.

sanskrit: yadā gārhapatyam asaparyait pūrvam agniṃ vadhūr iyam | adhā sarasvatyai nāri pitṛbhyaś ca namas kuru ||
english: When this bride has worshipped first the householder's fire, then, O woman, make obeisance to Sarasvatī and to the Fathers.

sanskrit: carma varmaitad ā hara- -asyai nāryā upastire | sinīvāli pra jāyatāṃ bhagasya sumatāv asat ||
english: Bring this hide as a protective armor, to be spread beneath this woman; may she bring forth through Sinīvālī; may she be in the good favor of Bhaga.

sanskrit: upa stṛṇīhi balbajam adhi carmaṇi rohite | tatropaviśya suprajā imam agniṃ saparyatu ||
english: Spread the balbaja grass upon the red skin; sitting down there, may she who has fine offspring worship this fire.

sanskrit: yaṃ balbajaṃ nyasyatha carma copastṛṇīthana | tad ā rohatu suprajā yā kanyā vindate patim ||
english: The balbaja grass that you lay down and the skin you spread beneath — upon that let her mount, she who has fine offspring, the maiden who wins a husband.

sanskrit: ā roha carmopa sīdāgnim eṣa devo hanti rakṣāṃsi sarvā | sumaṅgaly upa sīdemam agniṃ saṃpatnī prati bhūṣeha devān ||
english: Mount the hide, sit near the fire — this god destroys all demons; O most auspicious one, sit near this fire as a joint wife; honor the gods here.

sanskrit: pra jāyantāṃ mātur asyā upasthān nānārūpāḥ paśavo jāyamānāḥ | iha prajāṃ janaya patye asmai sujyaiṣṭhyo bhavatu te putra eṣaḥ ||
english: From this mother's lap may various forms of cattle be born into being; generate offspring here for this husband of yours; may this son of yours be excellent in seniority.

sanskrit: sumaṅgalī prataraṇī gṛhāṇāṃ suśeva patye śvaśurāya śambhūḥ | syonā śvaśruvai pra gṛhān viśemān prajāvatī jaradaṣṭir yathāsaḥ ||
english: Most auspicious, the one who leads the household onward, most pleasant to the husband, a source of happiness to the father-in-law, gentle to the mother-in-law — may you enter these homes; may you be rich in offspring, living to old age.

sanskrit: sumaṅgalīr iyaṃ vadhūr imāṃ sameta paśyata | saubhāgyam asyai dattvā daurbhāgyena paretana ||
english: This bride is most auspicious — come together and behold her; having given good fortune to her, depart with the misfortune.

sanskrit: yā durhārdo yuvatayo yāś ceha jaratīr api | varco hy asyai saṃ dattā- -athāstaṃ vi paretana ||
english: Whatever young women of ill heart are here, and whatever old women too — they have indeed bestowed vital radiance upon her; now depart to your homes.

sanskrit: rukmaprastaraṇaṃ vahyaṃ viśvā rūpāṇi bibhratam | ārohat sūryā sāvitrī bṛhate saubhagāya kam ||
english: The bridal chariot spread with gold, bearing all forms — upon it Sūryā, daughter of Savitā, has mounted for great good fortune.
